plays.desc_ko: Inspired가 상대 카운터픽(야스오) 대응으로 맵을 나눠 탑 사이드 정글로 카운터 정글링을 진행. 해설은 G2가 이를 와드로 파악하고 있었다고 언급.
plays.desc_en: Inspired (Lee Sin) splits the map and counter-jungles on the top side in response to G2's Yasuo counter-pick, though the casters note G2 had it spotted with wards.
plays.quote: Inspired is ... splitting the map because of the counter ... was up on the top side counter jungling.

plays.desc_ko: BrokenBlade가 와드 정보로 Inspired의 탑 사이드 존재를 알고 푸시를 멈추고 뒤로 물러남(위험 회피).
plays.desc_en: Knowing Inspired is topside thanks to ward info, BrokenBlade (Yasuo) stops pushing and backs off to avoid danger.
plays.quote: ward from G2 was placed after the Lion ... and Broken Blade off that push. ... He is kind of hovering back.

plays.desc_ko: Isles(레오나)가 바텀 2v2 교전을 시작해 트레이드를 연장함. 해설은 맵을 나눈 상태에서 소환사 주문 없이 공격적 2v2를 한 것이 좋지 않은 출발이었다고 평가. 이후 G2 정글 갱으로 Berserker가 첫 킬을 내줌.
plays.desc_en: Isles (Leona) starts and extends a bot 2v2 trade without summoner spells while the map is split, which the casters call a poor start; a G2 jungle gank then gives up first blood on Berserker (Varus).
plays.quote: And now Isles getting things kicked off, ... extending the trade just a little bit. ... the play because the beginning of that

plays.desc_ko: SkewMond(판테온)가 Inspired의 탑 사이드 위치 정보를 바탕으로 바텀에 갱. Labrov 훅-하스 사첼 콤보와 함께 Berserker를 묶었고, Isles 플래시로도 막지 못해 G2가 퍼스트 블러드 획득.
plays.desc_en: Using Inspired's topside location, SkewMond (Pantheon) ganks bot; Labrov's (Nautilus) hook and Hans Sama's (Ziggs) Satchel Charge combo lock down Berserker, and even Isles' Flash can't stop G2 from taking First Blood.
plays.quote: Looking to lock up Berserker. Berserker ... First blood for G2 Esports. ... Beautiful gank for G2 for SKON with

plays.desc_ko: 퍼스트 블러드 직후 Lion이 TP 합류와 Inspired 진입으로 SkewMond를 노려 '더블'을 시도. SkewMond는 플래시를 쓰고 Hans Sama의 몸막기 도움 속에 E(이지스 돌격)로 간신히 빠져나감. 해설은 Lion에게 거의 재앙이 될 뻔했다고 평가.
plays.desc_en: Right after First Blood, LYON look for a double with a Teleport and Inspired's (Lee Sin) engage on SkewMond (Pantheon), who flashes and barely escapes with Aegis Assault behind Hans Sama's body block; the casters say it nearly became a disaster for LYON.
plays.quote: TP back in. They're hoping to get a bit ... hoping to find the double. ... TIME JUST BARELY MAKES IT OUT.

plays.desc_ko: Labrov가 미드로 로밍하자 Inspired가 먼저 도착해 미드 3v2 상황을 만듦. Labrov는 훅으로 벽을 넘어 도주 준비, Lion은 이를 존중하고 추격하지 않음. Isles가 Labrov 위치를 잘 읽었고 훅을 옆걸음으로 피함.
plays.desc_en: When Labrov (Nautilus) roams mid, Inspired (Lee Sin) arrives first for a 3v2; Labrov readies a hook over the wall to escape and LYON respect it, while Isles (Leona) reads his position well and sidesteps the hook.
plays.quote: 3v2 in the favor ... hook to the wall to escape, but Lion are ... just going to respect it.

plays.desc_ko: SkewMond가 미드에 개입해 Saint를 압박(체력 크게 감소). Inspired가 레드 쪽으로 가다 미드 커버로 전환하고, Caps는 백스텝으로 버팀. G2는 Isles의 플래시를 빼냈고 해설은 G2가 짧은 교전에서 우위였다고 평가. 회고: Saint 플래시는 못 뺐지만 압박은 줌.
plays.desc_en: SkewMond (Pantheon) collapses mid and chunks Saint (Viktor) as Inspired switches from red side to cover and Caps (Cassiopeia) backsteps to survive; G2 burns Isles' Flash and win the short skirmish, applying pressure even without Saint's Flash.
plays.quote: his mid laner. Saint getting lower and ... the flash out from Isisles to escape. G2 ... getting the better of Lion in that brief

plays.desc_en: Dhokla (Gnar) teleports back with Mega Gnar rage stored as Inspired (Lee Sin) times his arrival on BrokenBlade, landing a wall stun to set up the combo; BrokenBlade kills Inspired but Dhokla takes him down for a one-for-one trade.
plays.quote: AND THIS MEANS LION ARE TAKING THE ... IT'S DLA WHO STRIKES BACK. THE TELEPORT ... That is one hell of a wall up on the

plays.desc_en: BrokenBlade (Yasuo) hits level 6, stacks his Q3 and dashes through minions to combo and kill Inspired (Lee Sin), before falling to Dhokla (Gnar) for a one-for-one trade.
plays.quote: LEVEL SIX FOR BROKEN BLADE HOPING ... BROKEN BLADE IS NASTY WITH ... for turning this back into a one for

plays.desc_en: Dhokla (Gnar) gets BrokenBlade (Yasuo) dunked once again in top lane, leaving the Teleport-less Yasuo losing more waves, while a one-for-one also happens mid at the same time.
plays.quote: Oh, we're not done. Another key play ... BLADE'S GETTING DUNKED ONCE AGAIN. HE ... no TP on the Oso.

plays.desc_ko: SkewMond 레벨 6 이후 미드가 전장이 됨. Labrov가 정글러 지원을 받아 Saint를 노리며 교전 개시, Caps는 궁 각을 찾지 못함. Lion 전원 합류로 G2가 자기 정글로 후퇴. 해설: G2의 과잉 커밋.

plays.quote: is the battlefield. ... jungler wants to make this happen. Nice ... this play. G2 overcommitting. Were not

plays.desc_ko: Saint가 플래시로 뒤로 빠지고 Victor 궁 + Inspired 킥으로 G2를 묶어 시간을 벌고, Isles·TP 합류한 Dhokla·Berserker(TP+플래시+궁)까지 Lion 5인이 모두 도착해 G2를 정글로 몰아 추격.
plays.desc_en: Saint flashes back and buys time with Viktor's Chaos Storm and Inspired's (Lee Sin) Dragon's Rage, as Isles (Leona), a teleporting Dhokla (Gnar) and Berserker (Varus) with Teleport, Flash and ultimate all arrive to chase G2 into the jungle.
plays.quote: flash back coming FROM SAINT. ... ALL FIVE OF LION ... HAVE ARRIVED IN THE PLAY AND G2 FORCED

plays.quote: inspired turns his sights on the grubs.

plays.desc_en: With Inspired delayed by his recall and jungle route and the lanes reset, G2 take the dragon, part of the early dragons they secured.
plays.quote: Dragon though for ... G2, they're going to be able to claim it ... Should be theirs as Inspired had to buy

plays.desc_ko: Labrov가 싸움을 찾아 앞으로 나와 메가 나르 직전/직후의 Dhokla에게 G2가 교전을 걸었으나 Isles·Inspired가 이미 도착해 있어 G2에게 '재앙'이 됨.
plays.desc_en: Labrov (Nautilus) steps up looking for a fight and G2 engage on Dhokla (Gnar) around his Mega transformation, but Isles and Inspired are already there, turning it into a disaster for G2.

plays.desc_ko: Dhokla가 다시 메가 나르로 변신하고 Lion 전원이 제자리에 있어 G2의 교전을 받아침(빠른 스턴 후 Inspired와 SkewMond 교전).
plays.desc_en: Dhokla turns Mega Gnar again and with all of LYON in position they answer G2's engage, landing a quick stun as Inspired (Lee Sin) fights SkewMond (Pantheon).
plays.quote: TO BE. TEAM PLAY FOR Lion and Mega Nar. ... Now Lion following the ... Quick stun.

plays.desc_ko: G2 전원이 미드 쪽에서 컨트롤 와드 3개를 깔고 매복(호버)했으나 Saint가 낌새를 채고 2차 타워까지 물러나 무산.

plays.desc_ko: Saint가 G2의 미드 매복을 감지하고 2차 타워까지 후퇴, Isles가 지원 와서 수비. 해설은 Lion이 통제된 플레이를 유지한다고 평가.
plays.desc_en: Saint (Viktor) reads G2's mid ambush and retreats to his tier 2 tower as Isles (Leona) comes to help defend; the casters praise LYON's controlled play.

plays.desc_ko: Lion이 탑 사이드에서 호버 플레이로 압박, Caps는 판테온 위치를 모르는 상황에서 존중하며 뒤로 물러남.
plays.desc_en: LYON hover and pressure on the top side, and Caps (Cassiopeia), unsure of Pantheon's location, respects it and backs off.
plays.quote: Caps playing with a lot of ... to back away on the top side. ... I think it's just a hover play

plays.quote: already on the way down. ... Zenith Blade ... has to flash over the wall.

plays.quote: Sonic wave not going to turn into a ... immediate ulti. They get the flash out ... Isle's also finding the flash here now

plays.desc_ko: G2가 Lion이 드래곤을 할 것으로 보고 탑 사이드에 모였으나 Lion이 위쪽에서 이에 대응. 추가 인원 투입 준비.
plays.desc_en: Expecting LYON to go for dragon, G2 group on the top side, but LYON answer from above while preparing to commit more members.
plays.quote: they are congregating around the top ... that Lion is taking dragon but Lion are ... actually up here kind of answering it.

plays.desc_ko: Saint가 바텀에 모습을 보인 뒤 크로스맵 플레이를 주지 않기 위해 웨이브를 밀어 넣고 귀환.
plays.desc_en: After showing bot, Saint (Viktor) shoves the wave and recalls to deny any cross-map play.
plays.quote: he is showing bottom lane. ... G2. So Saint ends up pushing that wave ... Basing once again

plays.quote: even invading the jungle. Lion now ... trying to take over the safe pathways of

plays.quote: mid lane looks like ... your outer defenses now down for G2.

plays.desc_ko: SkewMond가 체력 756의 전령을 강타 한 번에 가져가고(해설 'really smart smite') 포탑 아래로 돌아가려 함.
plays.desc_en: SkewMond (Pantheon) secures the Rift Herald at 756 HP with a single Smite, a really smart Smite, and looks to retreat under tower.
plays.quote: Good smite trying back UNDER THE TOWER. ... Really smart smite there by Skuman ... 756 health. So, Scuman one-shots the

plays.quote: Rob fishing maybe hoping to catch ... someone on a sloppy recall.

plays.desc_en: LYON group up and push through mid toward Caps or look to take control of Baron vision.
plays.quote: very much grouped up. ... mid lane the main focus moving up ... trying to control Baron vision with a

plays.desc_en: With Inspired topside, SkewMond (Pantheon) lands Grand Starfall on Berserker as G2 teleport in; Berserker escapes with Ghostblade, Saint flashes out, and Isles (Leona) goes back in and dies, as BrokenBlade's Wind Wall blocks the chase and Dhokla (Gnar) is hooked, burning his Flash before he can go Mega, costing Dhokla, Saint and Isles their Flashes.
plays.quote: Pantheon ... Ghost Blade to take him away. Saint now ... disengage, but IS recommitted to the

plays.desc_ko: Dhokla가 메가가 풀리며 낮은 체력이 되자 Lion이 교전을 포기하고 물러나 G2의 소울 포인트 드래곤을 내줌.

plays.desc_ko: Dhokla 사망 중 G2가 바론 지역을 장악하고 Cassiopeia가 빠르게 바론을 침. Lion의 시야가 부족한 상황. Inspired의 50/50 강타 여부가 질문으로 남음.
plays.desc_en: With Dhokla dead, G2 control the Baron area and Caps (Cassiopeia) quickly burns Baron while LYON lack vision, leaving open whether Inspired can win a 50/50 Smite.
plays.quote: G2 though going to take control of this ... And Cassiopia kills ... Can he take the 50/50?

plays.desc_ko: Berserker 궁이 Labrov에 적중(Hans Sama에는 연계 실패), Isles 연계로 Nautilus를 CC 체인. Saint가 벽을 넘어 Victor 궁으로 합류하고 존야로 생존, Inspired가 와드 점프로 추격. Hans Sama의 사첼 실수 후 Lion이 연속 처치, Saint 트리플. SkewMond와 Caps만 남는 Lion 일방적 교전.
plays.desc_en: Berserker's (Varus) Chain of Corruption hits Labrov but misses Hans Sama, Isles (Leona) chains CC on Nautilus, Saint (Viktor) joins over the wall with Chaos Storm and survives with Zhonya's, and Inspired (Lee Sin) ward hops to chase; after Hans Sama's Satchel Charge misplay LYON pick up kills in a row, with Saint taking a triple and only SkewMond and Caps left.
plays.quote: More importantly, Berserker ali ... connecting on LRAV. ... CHARGE TURNS INTO TWO FOR LION.
